observations: Four photos show tables with metal frames and wooden tops, designed to resemble sewing machines.
Each table has a rectangular metal frame with four legs, a central metal treadle mechanism, and a metal foot pedal.
The tops are made of wood with a visible grain pattern, and some have painted or stained surfaces.
The treadle mechanism includes a handwheel and a metal plate with measurement markings (photo 2).
The foot pedal is a metal grid with a small metal plate on it (photo 2).
The tables are placed on a cracked concrete surface outdoors, with dirt and debris around.
No brand or model is visible on any of the tables.
The seller claims these are 'Sewing and Weaving machine legs'.

claims.evidence: All photos show tables with metal frames, treadle mechanisms, and foot pedals, consistent with sewing machine legs.
Price is stated by seller but not visible in photos; cannot verify remotely.
Location is stated by seller but not visible in photos; cannot verify remotely.
